# SetButtonState

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetButtonState:Void button:Int32, state:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `button` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a button of style 2 or 3. |
| `state` | In | Int32 | required | 1 for ticked, 0 for not. |

## Description

Ticks or unticks a check box or radio button. Making a radio button ticked unticks the others in its group. It does not send an event.
